versions.localizedDescription:
feat: add content restriction bypass and anonymous stickers (#121)
* feat: add content restriction bypass and anonymous stickers
* feat: add separate regional restriction bypass
* revert: remove regional restriction bypass
* feat: preserve sticker pack access for sender
* feat: hide messages from blocked users
* refactor: remove new settings descriptions
* fix: hide blocked peers through the shadow-ban filters, key sticker sets by file
Blocked peers are kept per account in DGSimpleSettings: the whole list
once per launch while «Скрывать сообщения заблокированных» is on, then
every block and unblock, from other devices too. The shadow-ban state
includes the shown account's blocked peers, so chat list previews, reply
headers, in-app notifications, the pinned bar, search, typing and mentions
follow it, and «Показать скрытые» reveals them. Bots are never hidden.
Chats no longer request the list each time they open.
A sticker sent with «Анонимная отправка стикеров» keeps its set by the id
of the file the server made, in one capped dictionary per account, so a
published scheduled message finds it too, and «Посмотреть набор» shows
for it.
The toggles move to «Обход ограничений», «Стикеры и реакции» and
«Теневой бан» with footers and English strings; the content bypass asks
for a restart.
---------
Co-authored-by: kittenello <174290551+kittenello@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: catboysense <331888298+catboysense@users.noreply.github.com>
